_comment: The studio's shared audio library. Every invitation reads its loop from here rather than carrying
its own copy, so a track is encoded once and reused.
`clearedForClientWork` is the field that matters. A track is only true when its licence actually
permits use in a product sold to a third party — Pixabay Content License, CC0, or something bought
outright. A track licensed for nothing, or licensed only for the couple's own personal page, is
false, and must not be put on an invitation built for a paying client.
Encoding target: 57-90 s, MP3, under 650 KB, no leading or trailing silence, short fade into the

clearedForClientWorkReason: No licence is held for this recording. It is on Nidhi and Diptanshu's own invitation at their
explicit request and on their own decision — a private page shared by link with their own
guests. That is their call to make about their own wedding.
It must not be reused on an invitation sold to a client. That would be redistributing a
commercial recording as part of a paid product, which is a different act with a different
exposure: the client carries the risk, and the studio put it there.
